_about: The book's cursed-item table (CRB, Cursed Items) made executable for enchanting's
flawed bindings (docs/enchanting-revamp-plan.md §11; the owner's rounds 1 and 4 in
docs/enchanting-answers.md). Read by rules/curses.py, validated on load.
The top table is the book's own d%, unchanged. The sub-tables keep the book's rows
the owner did not drop and the engine can ask about, and re-scale the d% over
them: each kept row's width is its book width (an even split where the book prints
a list with no die), spread over 1-100 by the largest-remainder rule, which
tests/test_curses.py re-derives from `book_d100`. `dropped` lists every book row
that is not here and why.
Numbers are the book's: the save DC 10 + the item's caster level (written
"10 + cl", filled from the curse record), 1 point of ability damage, 1d4 rounds
stunned, one or two negative levels, -2 for blurred sight and the -2 cursed item,
5% unreliable, and remove curse's DC 10 + caster level. The split between
unreliable and dependent is the one house number (the book gives no die for which

rows.name: Delusion
rows.words: Delusion: it has no magic but the power to deceive. What it seems to do, it does not do.

rows.name: Opposite effect or target
rows.words: Opposite effect: every bonus it was meant to give is a penalty, and what it was meant to do to a foe it does to its bearer.

rows.name: Completely different effect
rows.words: Completely different effect: its magic works, and it is not the magic that was meant.

rows.name: A specific cursed item
rows.words: A cursed item: a -2 where the bonus should be, and it will not leave its bearer's hand until the curse is lifted.

intermittent.name: Unreliable
intermittent.words: Unreliable: each time it is used there is a 5% chance its magic gutters and does nothing.
intermittent.note: The book's uncontrolled variety is folded in here (plan §11.2): an item that activates itself means nothing for a blade or a ring with a standing bonus.

dependent.name: Within 10 feet of a creature type
In the hands of a nonspellcaster
dependent.situation: in the hands of someone who casts no spells

dependent.name: In the hands of a spellcaster
dependent.situation: in the hands of a spellcaster

dependent.name: In one phase of the day
dependent.reworded: The book's 'on holy days or during particular astrological events'. The owner's round 4 point 10: no planets, phases of the day only, so the row asks nothing of the world.

requirement.name: Eats twice as much
requirement.words: Requirement: its bearer must eat twice what a body needs each day, or its magic sleeps.

requirement.name: Sleeps twice as long
requirement.words: Requirement: its bearer must sleep twice as long each day, or its magic sleeps.

requirement.name: Used every day
requirement.words: Requirement: it must be used every day, or it stops working for whoever holds it.

requirement.name: Draws blood every day
requirement.words: Requirement: it must draw blood every day, or its magic sleeps.
requirement.reworded: The book's 'must draw blood when drawn, and cannot be sheathed until it has'; the plan's daily reading (§11.2), since no op sheathes a blade.

requirement.name: A kill every day
requirement.words: Requirement: it must have a living creature killed by its bearer every day, or its magic sleeps.

requirement.name: No other magic
requirement.words: Requirement: its bearer may carry no other magic item, or its magic sleeps.

drawback.name: Hair grows
drawback.words: Drawback: its bearer's hair grows an inch every hour.

drawback.name: Shrinks or grows
drawback.words: Drawback: its bearer {taller_words} six inches, once.

drawback.name: Colder air
drawback.words: Drawback: the air around it is always cooler, as though it drank the warmth.

drawback.name: Warmer air
drawback.words: Drawback: the air around it is always warmer, close and stale.

drawback.name: Hair colour
drawback.words: Drawback: its bearer's hair has changed colour.

drawback.name: Skin colour
drawback.words: Drawback: its bearer's skin has changed colour.

drawback.name: A mark
drawback.words: Drawback: its bearer carries a mark anyone can see: a sign on the skin, a faint glow.

drawback.name: A sound
drawback.words: Drawback: it never stops making a faint, disturbing sound.

drawback.name: Ridiculous
drawback.words: Drawback: it looks ridiculous, garish and wrongly shaped.

drawback.name: Possessive
drawback.words: Drawback: its bearer grows selfishly possessive of it.

drawback.name: Paranoid
drawback.words: Drawback: its bearer frets that it will be lost or harmed.

drawback.name: Stunned
drawback.words: Drawback: once a day, at no hour it chooses, it stuns its bearer for 1d4 rounds.

drawback.name: Blurred vision
drawback.words: Drawback: its bearer's sight blurs: -2 on attacks, saves and Perception.

drawback.name: A negative level
drawback.words: Drawback: its bearer carries a negative level while it is held or worn.

drawback.name: Two negative levels
drawback.words: Drawback: its bearer carries two negative levels while it is held or worn.

drawback.name: Will or Intelligence
drawback.words: Drawback: each day its bearer makes a Will save (DC {dc}) or loses a point of Intelligence.

drawback.name: Will or Wisdom
drawback.words: Drawback: each day its bearer makes a Will save (DC {dc}) or loses a point of Wisdom.

drawback.name: Will or Charisma
drawback.words: Drawback: each day its bearer makes a Will save (DC {dc}) or loses a point of Charisma.

drawback.name: Fortitude or Constitution
drawback.words: Drawback: each day its bearer makes a Fortitude save (DC {dc}) or loses a point of Constitution.

drawback.name: Fortitude or Strength
drawback.words: Drawback: each day its bearer makes a Fortitude save (DC {dc}) or loses a point of Strength.

drawback.name: Fortitude or Dexterity
drawback.words: Drawback: each day its bearer makes a Fortitude save (DC {dc}) or loses a point of Dexterity.

drawback.name: No arcane spells
drawback.words: Drawback: while it is held or worn its bearer cannot cast arcane spells.

drawback.name: No divine spells
drawback.words: Drawback: while it is held or worn its bearer cannot cast divine spells.

drawback.name: No spells
drawback.words: Drawback: while it is held or worn its bearer cannot cast any spell.

dropped.name: Gender changes
dropped.why: Owner, round 4 point 3: dropped.

dropped.name: Race or kind changes
dropped.why: Owner, round 4 point 3: dropped.

dropped.name: An incurable disease
dropped.why: Owner, round 4 point 3: dropped.

dropped.name: Alignment changes
dropped.why: Owner, round 4 point 3: dropped (and no alignment is tracked, Q7).

dropped.name: Must attack the nearest creature
dropped.why: Owner, round 4 point 3: the compulsion to attack is dropped.

dropped.name: Polymorphed
dropped.why: Owner, round 4 point 3: dropped.

dropped.name: Choose or invent a drawback
dropped.why: GM fiat with no rule row is refused (docs/states-effects-tells.md); the row is spread over the rest.

dropped.name: Above or below freezing
dropped.why: No temperature is modelled, so the condition could never be asked.

dropped.name: In or out of direct sunlight
dropped.why: No light or shelter is modelled; day and night are kept.

dropped.name: Underwater or out of water
dropped.why: No water is modelled.

dropped.name: Near a race or kind
dropped.why: The world owns its peoples (they are not the rulebook's races); the creature type row covers kinds.

dropped.name: Near an arcane or divine caster
dropped.why: Nothing reads a creature's casting tradition.

dropped.name: In the hands of an alignment
dropped.why: No alignment is tracked (owner, round 4 Q7): waived, not reworded, because the row has no meaning without it.

dropped.name: In the hands of a gender
dropped.why: The owner dropped the gender rows (round 4 point 3); the same reason holds.

dropped.name: More than 100 miles from a site
dropped.why: Nothing measures distance to a named site.

dropped.name: Completes a quest
dropped.why: No quest has an ending the engine can read.

dropped.name: Destroys 100 gp of valuables daily, or 2,000 gp of magic weekly
dropped.why: No op destroys valuables.

dropped.name: Swears fealty, worships a deity, takes a name, adds a class
dropped.why: None of these is recorded anywhere a reader could ask.

dropped.name: Keeps ranks in a skill
dropped.why: The book prints no number of ranks; inventing one is a house number with no source.

dropped.name: Sacrifices 2 Constitution once
dropped.why: No first-use hook exists to take it at.

dropped.name: Daily holy water, monthly lava, a daily spell cast on it
dropped.why: No op anoints, immerses or casts on an item.
